messages:
mike: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem — we saw a 3-hour ingest stall that caused delayed token events and a handful of wrong invoice lines. I sketched owners below; please ack or swap by EOD PT.

tara: Can you drop the list of impacted invoices/accounts? I want to prep CS comms.

mike: Exported file: `delayed_ingest_accounts_2026-03-19.csv`. Query used: `select account_id, invoice_id, sum(token_delta) as delta from metering where ingest_status='lagged' and ts >= '2026-03-19' group by account_id, invoice_id order by delta desc limit 50;`

nisha: I'll own the reconciliation job and automation. Plan: run the replay worker with --reconcile-only on staging, compare pre/post token sums, then schedule write job. ETA: 36 hours. I'll include an idempotency marker so we can safely retry.

ops-review: Suggest adding a verification harness: compare `tokens_by_account` (ledger) against `event_stream` aggregates and surface any >0.5% mismatch as a fail.

mike: Owners list:
- reconciliation job + idempotent write (owner: nisha)
- ledger delta review + rollback plan (owner: tara, reviewer: ops-review)
- invoice correction plan & CS templates (owner: tara)
- small customer credits (<$2k auto-approved) (owner: finance-leads)
- unusual credits >$2k require exec signoff (owner: finance-leads)
- monitoring & recurrence detection (owner: ops-review)

tara: For the invoice corrections I propose two tracks: (A) quick credits applied to next invoice for accounts with delta < $500, (B) reissued invoices for deltas >= $500 or where legal requires it. Will share the mapping spreadsheet.

mike: Risk note: if the replay worker hits partial failures we'll prefer targeted credits vs mass reissues to avoid impacting accounting periods. Finance needs to sign off on any >$2k credits.

nisha: Dry-run snippet from staging:```
[2026-03-21T14:01:02Z] reconcile-only mode started
[2026-03-21T14:01:12Z] account=1834 events_replayed=2,340 tokens_delta=2340
[2026-03-21T14:01:12Z] verification: tokens_ledger_before=120340 tokens_expected=122680 mismatch=2340 (1.94%)
[2026-03-21T14:01:12Z] reconcile-only result: fail -> requires manual review for account 1834
```

ops-review: Alert rule proposal: create a Datadog composite monitor that fires when `sum(last_1h):increase(metering.ingest.delay, last_1h) > 1h` OR `billing.token_mismatch_pct > 0.5` for more than 10 minutes. Hook to PagerDuty.

finance-leads: We'll handle approvals for any credits over $2k. Please include projected $ impact in the spreadsheet and tag us.

tara: I'll draft CS note: "Heads up: we found delayed usage ingestion on 3/19 that affected some invoices. We're issuing credits or corrected invoices as needed; details in the ticket linked below." Will share templated variants.

mike: Checklist for next updates: 1) nisha posts reconcile job summary + list of accounts with mismatch >0.5%; 2) tara posts invoice mapping and proposed action per account; 3) ops-review confirms alert tests; 4) finance-leads confirm approval thresholds. Next update by 2026-03-22 17:00 UTC.

billingbot: Incident BLG-2026-03-19-02 noted: owners assigned (nisha, tara, ops-review, finance-leads). Next update requested 2026-03-22T17:00:00Z.

nisha: :thumbsup: I'll post the reconcile run output and the idempotency checks by tomorrow morning.

tara: :thumbsup: will sync with CS and push draft templates.

mike: Thanks everyone. React with :white_check_mark: once you confirm your task to help me compile the final action tracker.

finance-leads: :white_check_mark:
